label: Oral & Silent Reading Fluency
raw_text: Demonstrate oral and silent reading fluency while reading grade-level texts for understanding, self-correcting as necessary to ensure accuracy and aid comprehension.
child_texts: Increase sight word vocabulary using decoding skills by reading grade-appropriate regularly and irregularly spelled words, including high-frequency words, in isolation and context with increasing automaticity.
Read a wide range of grade-level texts aloud with increasing accuracy.
Read a wide range of grade-level texts aloud with appropriate prosody (phrasing, expression, juncture/pause, and intonation) to demonstrate understanding.
Self-correct while reading text (silently or aloud) to improve comprehension and fluency, rereading as necessary.
competency_statement: Read grade-level texts aloud and silently with accuracy, expression, and self-correction to support understanding.
observable_behaviors: Read grade-appropriate words, including high-frequency and irregularly spelled words, with increasing automaticity.
Read aloud a variety of grade-level texts accurately.
Use phrasing, expression, pauses, and intonation appropriately when reading aloud to show understanding.
Notice and correct mistakes while reading aloud or silently, rereading as needed to improve comprehension and fluency.
